_comment: Copy this to scripts/oracle_vm_config.json and fill in the three REQUIRED fields. The rest are auto-discovered or have sensible defaults. OCIDs are not secrets; your API private key (in ~/.oci/config) is the secret and is NOT in this file.
ssh_authorized_key: ssh-rsa AAAA... your public key so you can log in (paste the whole line, or leave empty)
